notes.title: Playtest for NextFest
notes.content:
🎉 Next Fest Update: Extended Playtest and New Patch Live! 🎉

We’re excited to announce that due to the fantastic feedback and enthusiasm from the recent playtest, we're keeping it active throughout Next Fest!

[b]Patch Highlights:[/b]

[list]
[*]New Questlines: Embark on the start of two new questlines, adding more depth and adventure.
[*]Enhanced Audio: Experience updated sound effects designed to immerse you further.
[*]Gameplay Balancing: We’ve fine-tuned balance based on player feedback to keep the experience engaging.
[*]Extended Play Sessions: Play longer with extended timer settings.
[*]Bug Fixes: Enjoy a smoother gameplay experience with our latest fixes.

So gear up, get blastin’, and dive into Next Fest with us!

notes.title: Nextfest Playtest
notes.content:
The recent playtest was a huge success, so we’ve decided to keep it running throughout Next Fest!

[b]What’s new in this patch:[/b]

[list]
[*]The introduction of two new questlines to dive into. 
[*]Refined and updated sound effects for a more immersive experience. 
[*]Gameplay balancing adjustments based on your valuable feedback. 
[*]Extended play session timers for longer playtime. 
[*]Various bug fixes to improve overall stability. 
[/list]

[b]Get blastin' and enjoy Next Fest![/b]

notes.title: Update based on playtest feedback
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for the feedback we have received. We have rolled out an update to the playtest based on everyone's feedback.  Here's a list of the highlights.

Increased the amount of enemies.
Fixed reloading bug.
Replaced missing element of Plasma blast visual (more work to be done)
Some VFX updates.
You now get the option to heal when you level up.
Improved performance on lower end hardware (steam deck).
Improved controller support.
Pause to see your skill picks (esc/back)

Thanks again for your help and happy blastin!
